PierWallFins.title: C006 - Pier Wall, Hairpins and Fin Plates

visible_sentences_changed: Outside this calculation: wall flexure, shear and lateral or seismic load paths; concrete splitting, breakout and the transfer below the lowest ring; pipe-shell bending and ovalization; global pile interaction, ring-segment splices, fatigue, corrosion and WPS or fabrication acceptance; confirmation of the pile stiffness lengths. The fin-plate and hairpin support concept (the former C006) was withdrawn from the project on 22 October 2026 and is not evaluated here.
